title: Lens: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Lens loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Bind Lens to a comfortable slot and scan common machines near base so you know what normal output looks like before a crisis.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: The first Lens habit is scanning before spending. Identify an unknown block, machine, crop, or hazard before committing resources or bodies to it.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Lens is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
